ops.statement: Any background Agent-tool teammate's spawn prompt must explicitly require delivering its result via SendMessage to 'main' before ending its turn. Teammates without that line routinely end on a bare idle notification with the report undelivered, costing one nudge round-trip each; teammates with it mostly deliver unprompted. Same family as crew idle-no-verdict adjudication, applied at dispatch-authoring time.
ops.grounding: .agent-work/AGENT_FEEDBACK.md 2026-07-09 issue-99, Friction bullet 1 (repo-audit, both plan-alternative agents, and one critic each needed a SendMessage nudge; critics with the explicit instruction delivered)

ops.statement: Never edit a shipped compact-format JSON template by round-tripping it through json.load/json.dump — the formatter reflows the whole file (hundreds-of-line diff for a 2-line change), destroying blame and review signal. Edit the raw text surgically; validate with json.load afterward.
ops.grounding: .agent-work/AGENT_FEEDBACK.md 2026-07-09 issue-99, Friction bullet 2 (T1 c4/c5 split first committed as a 363-line reflow, reset and redone as a 2+/1- text edit, 5fad3e3)

ops.statement: When a gate creates a NEW tracked-to-be file, the handoff must state that the file is untracked until staged: 'git diff shows N-1 files; the new file appears in git status'. Otherwise a scope claim like 'diff touches exactly N files' reads as false against a correct working tree and the reviewer momentarily mistrusts correct evidence.
